_comment: Which IIIF templates get rendered, against which fixtures, and how the output is judged.
Scope is deliberately IIIF only. Every Metadata Display in twig/metadatadisplays is
still syntax-checked by tools/twig-lint; this tier renders the IIIF ones and checks
what they produce, because those are the documents that break viewers and
'mimetype' mirrors what the Metadata Display entity declares on the site. 'iiif': true
additionally parses the result with iiif-prezi3. 'fragment': true means the template
emits an embeddable snippet rather than a whole document, so it is wrapped in braces
before being parsed -- see the note on the thumbnails below.
A template with 'skip' is NOT covered. Each one queries for other objects, so no
amount of fixture data makes it renderable offline. The reason is recorded rather
than left as a silent omission.
No 'defaults.fixtures' key on purpose: render-check.php falls back to every fixture
file present (array_keys($fixtures)) when a template entry doesn't list its own.
Dropping a new fixture into tools/twig-render/fixtures/*.json is enough to have it
picked up everywhere -- no second place to remember to update. Give a template its
own 'fixtures' list only to deliberately narrow it, not to add to this default set.

templates.note: The manifest viewers load most. Full Presentation 3 validation via iiif-prezi3.
Presentation 2.1. iiif-prezi3 models Presentation 3, so parsing a 2.1 manifest with it would fail for the wrong reason. JSON validity only.
Emits canvases for embedding in a series manifest. Parses as a whole document, but is not a standalone IIIF resource, so the model does not apply to it entire.

Emits a bare "thumbnail": [...] member, not a document. Wrapped in braces before parsing: a trailing comma or unbalanced bracket here corrupts every manifest that embeds it, which is worth catching even though the snippet is not valid JSON on its own.
Same shape as the above. This is the template that carried three Twig 3 syntax errors and was rejected outright by Archipelago until they were fixed.

templates.skip: Calls drupal_view() to find member objects. Needs a database.
Calls drupal_view() and bamboo_load_entity(). Needs a database.
Calls sbf_drupal_view_paged() and bamboo_load_entity(). Needs a database.
